title: Application Security & OWASP
intro: Application security interviews test whether you can reason about threats, not just recite acronyms. This module opens with security architecture (the defense-in-depth model), then the OWASP Top 10 — the canonical vulnerability list every interviewer references. From there it builds outward: encryption (the math you must get right), secrets management (where keys actually live), secure coding (the patterns that prevent the OWASP issues), then verification — vulnerability scanning and security testing. It closes with compliance, the comparison canon, and scenario-based questions where the threats meet real code.
